What a week it has been. If you are tired - angry - wondering how to keep going - I'm here with you. The warning bells of fascism are ringing louder, closer, and more urgently every day.
Earlier this week, I saw the news that Tennessee House Speaker Sexton [stripped Democratic lawmakers of all committee assignments](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/544fa701-832f-4c09-b763-87cb182dbb09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to punish them for protesting last week's map-shifting power-grab. As other red states rush to redraw their districts and create a "[one party state in the American South](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/13289f24-b098-46c4-b87a-22de768fdd8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," as Heather Cox Richardson writes, I've been thinking about my team's trip to Nashville last week to protest our own state's redistricting.
Leaders in red states redrawing these maps are not just relying on a structural shift to maintain the balance of power - they're relying on a psychological shift, too.
Some of you know that much of my career has involved sustainability and behavioral science, which is where I learned to put my big feelings around complex, seemingly insurmountable problems into solution-oriented actions. There's a parallel to what we are experiencing right now that I think can help keep the stubborn spark of hope and action alive within you.
Sometime in the last decade, those with an interest in maintaining the fossil-fuel-dependent status quo switched strategies. They stopped promoting climate _denialism_ - the idea that climate change is a hoax - because folks could see and feel how our changing climate was impacting them personally. Instead, the strategy switched to climate _doomerism_ - the idea that things were too far gone for us to do anything about it.
**The end result of both of these strategies, denial and doom, takes people out of the fight. In one instance, because you don 't think it's happening, and in another, because you don't think there's anything you can do.**
**Sound familiar?**
When many of us were ringing the alarm bells about Project 2025, authoritarianism, and the decline of our democracy, the first response was: _that 's not going to happen. _Now, the message they seem to want us to internalize is: _it is happening - and there's nothing you can do about it. _But that's not true, for climate or for our democracy.
**They are only trying to dilute, weaken, and take away our power** _**because we are powerful.**_**They wouldn 't be doing any of this if we didn't scare them.**
I am not going to let them take away my joy, my determination, and my energy to keep showing up. I'm also not going to let them convince me of the lie that we the people don't have power. I am too stubborn to let these megalomaniac lunatics drive our country into the ground without a fight.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1ce9884a-ef3a-4a96-8d8f-b1eb46626db5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
###### _Photo credit: Saturn and Sun Collective_
**If you 're with me and wondering what we **_**do**_** - I need your help. I have two concrete asks for you.**
We know we have to show up at the polls in undeniable numbers. For this race, we need to get about 150,000 voters to cast a vote for me this November. Here's the behind-the-scenes you may not know about how campaigns focus their efforts.
If I know you're already voting for me, my team and I can stop trying to convince you with texts, phone calls, canvasses, and ads. We can target those efforts on all the folks that still need to learn about our campaign or be persuaded. It also means that during early voting and on election day, we can focus all our efforts on getting people who've said they'll vote for me to the polls.
**So if you 're going to vote for me, [will you add your name here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8d947bbd-6ac3-462d-a7fc-328cd3096b20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?**
**Here 's the second thing I need: your help identifying people who already plan to vote for me, convincing those who aren't sure, and helping us get both groups to the polls in August and November.**
We need a wave they can't rig their way out of, and guess what? A conversation with a friend or family member makes people 8.3% more likely to vote. If every one of our supporters helps get their networks excited about this race AND to the polls - we will win this.
I know a lot of y'all are already talking with folks about the stakes of this race. To help you with those conversations AND let us know who's already a supporter, we've launched a new tool through an app called _[Empower](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cee3cfe7-dd8b-4484-a058-dd3b7842feac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_.
**We made a guide to get you started in just a few minutes,[which you can access on my website](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/26b1d993-208e-4545-8b52-3b8daa7800af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
**Want help getting set up?** Join our next virtual [Camp Cavalry on Wednesday, May 20th](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d72491a8-b05f-4bcc-b150-1288752b5c46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Our field team will walk you through the app live and make sure you leave ready to go.
**Don 't like a mobile app and need a way to track your conversations on paper?** [You can download and print our conversation log here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/beb48c8d-fbce-476a-badd-ddb9ed21cf0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You're welcome to bring it to any campaign event or email it to our field department at [field@michaelafortennessee.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7d8814f3-3484-4689-94e4-8268aa522df0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
They're going to continue to lie, cheat, confuse, and demoralize us to maintain power.
But I am not in the business of giving up, and I know that you aren't, either. I propose we take on the business of stubbornly refusing to let them win by organizing our friends, families, and neighbors in ways we never have before.
Tim Burchett has Donald Trump, the GOP establishment, and the benefit of incumbency and name recognition. **I have you and everyone you know.** Out of those two groups, I know who I'm betting on.
In stubborn persistence and resistance,
Michaela

Fighting back against one-party rule in Tennessee | | | May 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | What a week it has been. If you are tired - angry - wondering how to keep going - I'm here with you. The warning bells of fascism are ringing louder, closer, and more urgently every day. Earlier this week, I saw the news that Tennessee House Speaker Sexton to punish them for protesting last week's map-shifting power-grab. As other red states rush to redraw their districts and create a "," as Heather Cox Richardson writes, I've been thinking about my team's trip to Nashville last week to protest our own state's redistricting. Leaders in red states redrawing these maps are not just relying on a structural shift to maintain the balance of power - they're relying on a psychological shift, too. Some of you know that much of my career has involved sustainability and behavioral science, which is where I learned to put my big feelings around complex, seemingly insurmountable problems into solution-oriented actions. There's a parallel to what we are experiencing right now that I think can help keep the stubborn spark of hope and action alive within you. Sometime in the last decade, those with an interest in maintaining the fossil-fuel-dependent status quo switched strategies. They stopped promoting climate denialism - the idea that climate change is a hoax - because folks could see and feel how our changing climate was impacting them personally. Instead, the strategy switched to climate doomerism - the idea that things were too far gone for us to do anything about it. The end result of both of these strategies, denial and doom, takes people out of the fight. In one instance, because you don 't think it's happening, and in another, because you don't think there's anything you can do. Sound familiar? When many of us were ringing the alarm bells about Project 2025, authoritarianism, and the decline of our democracy, the first response was: that 's not going to happen. Now, the message they seem to want us to internalize is: it is happening - and there's nothing you can do about it. But that's not true, for climate or for our democracy. They are only trying to dilute, weaken, and take away our power because we are powerful.They wouldn 't be doing any of this if we didn't scare them. I am not going to let them take away my joy, my determination, and my energy to keep showing up. I'm also not going to let them convince me of the lie that we the people don't have power. I am too stubborn to let these megalomaniac lunatics drive our country into the ground without a fight. | | ---|---|--- Photo credit: Saturn and Sun Collective If you 're with me and wondering what we do - I need your help. I have two concrete asks for you. We know we have to show up at the polls in undeniable numbers. For this race, we need to get about 150,000 voters to cast a vote for me this November. Here's the behind-the-scenes you may not know about how campaigns focus their efforts. If I know you're already voting for me, my team and I can stop trying to convince you with texts, phone calls, canvasses, and ads. We can target those efforts on all the folks that still need to learn about our campaign or be persuaded. It also means that during early voting and on election day, we can focus all our efforts on getting people who've said they'll vote for me to the polls. So if you 're going to vote for me, ? Here 's the second thing I need: your help identifying people who already plan to vote for me, convincing those who aren't sure, and helping us get both groups to the polls in August and November. We need a wave they can't rig their way out of, and guess what? A conversation with a friend or family member makes people 8.3% more likely to vote. If every one of our supporters helps get their networks excited about this race AND to the polls - we will win this. I know a lot of y'all are already talking with folks about the stakes of this race. To help you with those conversations AND let us know who's already a supporter, we've launched a new tool through an app called . We made a guide to get you started in just a few minutes,. Want help getting set up? Join our next virtual . Our field team will walk you through the app live and make sure you leave ready to go. Don 't like a mobile app and need a way to track your conversations on paper? . You're welcome to bring it to any campaign event or email it to our field department at . They're going to continue to lie, cheat, confuse, and demoralize us to maintain power. But I am not in the business of giving up, and I know that you aren't, either. I propose we take on the business of stubbornly refusing to let them win by organizing our friends, families, and neighbors in ways we never have before. Tim Burchett has Donald Trump, the GOP establishment, and the benefit of incumbency and name recognition. I have you and everyone you know. Out of those two groups, I know who I'm betting on. And yes — we need a 15-to-20-year moratorium on immigration so this country can finally get a real headcount, secure the border, and figure out who is actually here. That is not radical. That is basic national survival. I'm that guy. I will say the thing every consultant, donor-class puppet, and establishment coward is too afraid to say: If we don't get control of our borders, our cities, our schools, our jobs, and our country — we won't have a country left. The answer is not more excuses. The answer is not more taxpayer-funded resettlement. The answer is not letting foreign conflicts, foreign cultures, and foreign problems get dumped into American neighborhoods while working families are told to shut up and pay the bill. America First means Americans come first. Period. And that is exactly why Michele Tafoya refused to show up to the Minnesota GOP Senate Primary debate this past week. She knew she would be exposed. She knew voters would see the truth. Tafoya does not support a real America First agenda. She does not support the kind of border security this moment demands. She was hand-selected by the DC establishment because they know she can be controlled, packaged, and pushed through the system without ever having to answer the hard questions. That is why she hid. That is why she ducked the debate. That is why she thinks she can skip the voters and still walk into the nomination. Not on my watch. Minnesota deserves a fighter who will show up, tell the truth, and put this country first without apology. I am not running to impress the donor class. I am not running to protect the establishment. subject: Stop Taking Our Healthcare
body:
Healthcare Cuts Cause Concerns in Rural Virginia
| | |
---
| |
---
| Friends-
This week, we met with community members in Franklin, Virginia alongside Affordable Virginia to discuss the possible closure of the only area hospital, as well as other health care access issues.
Representative Jen Kiggans has stood firm behind her vote for the One Big Beautiful Bill despite the threat it poses to healthcare in rural communities like Franklin. Participants shed light on the struggles the community is facing, including one of the highest diabetes rates in Virginia. Healthcare cuts could deepen existing disparities in predominantly minority and low-income communities.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Dear Friend, A week ago, our friend Tyler Bowyer from TPUSA [posted](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjoIvpag6gfs87Gm10ykfcgMFuoQdapeZBoHInQF9iSdL1azRidYoJcbydMHbgznuOw-3D-3DDAaR_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHeraQgU-2Feo474LBTlCU8qMtc4y5fIEmYNy-2BFhjDA7XCu9QlY6Whu7Bm0TbbYKeASGASC77FAZ-2BaT0C7qNE08SkRB06n2oXF-2FK19BJ1dtijqgLphi8gNN2ookKV9-2FZVj3BaiURO3bJh2fP9SndK9WDonL36IDxhm69XsL7SbygWJEUKwDw29ef-2BlfXYqBZLTIFY-2FXZPjQ9RUOClYP7EneCw1o-2BlqATuMFfA7uFhElN3Q2-2Bk-3D) a short but powerful observation on X (formerly known as Twitter):**“In deep red states like Indiana, Mississippi, Alabama – a large percentage of ‘moderate Republicans’ are actually Democrats. Never forget this.”** I replied that this is the most underreported fact in politics right now.And it’s true.Sadly, there are **THOUSANDS** of these fake Republicans in state legislatures across the country. Some are in blue states where they operate as the “loyal opposition,” quietly helping Democrats maintain power while pretending to oppose them. Others are in deep red states where Republicans hold enormous supermajorities that should be capable of passing transformative conservative reforms.But those reforms never happen.Why? Because the Uniparty in control often serves lobbyists, corporate interests, government bureaucracies, and leadership power structures instead of the conservative voters who elected them.That is why state Freedom Caucuses exist.Not simply to complain about the problem, but to expose it, educate voters, pressure lawmakers, and ultimately replace fake Republicans with actual conservatives. This week provided several perfect examples.
---
|
---
**SOUTH CAROLINA** For months, the **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** and **House Freedom Caucus member Ralph Norman** have been leading the push to redraw South Carolina’s congressional map after the Supreme Court’s _Callais_ decision dealt a major blow to racial gerrymandering.The goal is straightforward:A constitutional 7-0 Republican congressional delegation.The **Freedom Caucus Fund** just released a new ad highlighting the partnership between Ralph Norman and the South Carolina Freedom Caucus to make that happen.Watch the ad [here](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjkndoke-2BUr-2F0dn59X0EHCru8FhHLKtBem4KEEDGUrHxFoZGLZBf8T120h9oRX3iMvw-3D-3D_RIg_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHeraQgU-2Feo474LBTlCU8qMtc4y5fIEmYNy-2BFhjDA7XCu9QlY6Whu7Bm0TbbYKeASGASC77FAZ-2BaT0C7qNE08SkRB06n2oXF-2FK19BJ1dtijqgLobWz-2FDWijATF1hB5kUWLDHbGHgIJ1YiiukrOt-2B9RU0XEC76WZsw77J6y2rP8kXMZrnk-2F3Kt-2BIKUFAtv1dqNM4hX1xgl3-2FwQWGjEaSZngSu2R8c4MisrmopSb41mKe1uf8-3D):

But the fight has exposed exactly how the Uniparty operates.A few days ago, the South Carolina Senate killed the redistricting effort, despite overwhelming support from conservative voters.Why?Because liberal Republican State Senators joined Democrats to block it.Pressure immediately intensified from:**⚡️** The White House**⚡️** Ralph Norman**⚡️** The South Carolina Freedom Caucus**⚡️** Grassroots activistsThe pressure worked.Governor McMaster was forced to call a special session on redistricting.The South Carolina House reconvenes today and is expected to pass the new map quickly. The Senate returns Monday.But the fight is far from over.Opponents in the Senate are now expected to slow-walk the legislation until May 26, when early voting begins for congressional primaries. If they can delay long enough, they may be able to kill the map for this election cycle entirely.That is how the Uniparty plays the game.And that is why Freedom Caucuses matter. They force fights the establishment wants to avoid.
---
|
---
**MARYLAND** The State Freedom Caucus strategy is not just legislative. It is electoral.This week, the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** endorsed conservative challenger Derek Howell against incumbent Republican Delegate Kevin Hornberger.Why? Because Hornberger’s record is not conservative by any honest measure.He voted for:**⚡️** The Democrat budget**⚡️** Green New Deal-style policies**⚡️** Social justice mandates tied to SPLC-written frameworks used in Maryland schools No self-respecting conservative Republican should be voting for policies like these.The **Maryland Freedom Caucus** is making it clear that simply having an “R” next to your name is not enough.
---
|
---
**OKLAHOMA** If anyone still doubts Tyler Bowyer’s observation, look no further than Oklahoma.Republicans control the Oklahoma State Senate by a massive 40-8 margin. And yet, this week, legislation prohibiting illegal aliens from receiving Medicaid benefits failed by a vote of 14-32.Read that again.A conservative reform backed by the **Oklahoma Freedom Caucus** failed in a chamber dominated by Republicans.Why? Because liberal Republicans joined Democrats to kill it.The Oklahoma Freedom Caucus posted the final vote tally publicly (see below) so voters can see exactly who blocked the legislation.This is exactly why so many voters in deep red states feel betrayed.They elect Republicans expecting conservative governance and instead receive a watered-down version of Democrat policy.

clean_body: | | | | | Dear Friend, A week ago, our friend Tyler Bowyer from TPUSA a short but powerful observation on X (formerly known as Twitter):“In deep red states like Indiana, Mississippi, Alabama – a large percentage of ‘moderate Republicans’ are actually Democrats. Never forget this.” I replied that this is the most underreported fact in politics right now.And it’s true.Sadly, there are THOUSANDS of these fake Republicans in state legislatures across the country. Some are in blue states where they operate as the “loyal opposition,” quietly helping Democrats maintain power while pretending to oppose them. Others are in deep red states where Republicans hold enormous supermajorities that should be capable of passing transformative conservative reforms.But those reforms never happen.Why? Because the Uniparty in control often serves lobbyists, corporate interests, government bureaucracies, and leadership power structures instead of the conservative voters who elected them.That is why state Freedom Caucuses exist.Not simply to complain about the problem, but to expose it, educate voters, pressure lawmakers, and ultimately replace fake Republicans with actual conservatives. This week provided several perfect examples. | SOUTH CAROLINA For months, the South Carolina Freedom Caucus and House Freedom Caucus member Ralph Norman have been leading the push to redraw South Carolina’s congressional map after the Supreme Court’s Callais decision dealt a major blow to racial gerrymandering.The goal is straightforward:A constitutional 7-0 Republican congressional delegation.The Freedom Caucus Fund just released a new ad highlighting the partnership between Ralph Norman and the South Carolina Freedom Caucus to make that happen.Watch the ad : But the fight has exposed exactly how the Uniparty operates.A few days ago, the South Carolina Senate killed the redistricting effort, despite overwhelming support from conservative voters.Why?Because liberal Republican State Senators joined Democrats to block it.Pressure immediately intensified from:⚡️ The White House⚡️ Ralph Norman⚡️ The South Carolina Freedom Caucus⚡️ Grassroots activistsThe pressure worked.Governor McMaster was forced to call a special session on redistricting.The South Carolina House reconvenes today and is expected to pass the new map quickly. The Senate returns Monday.But the fight is far from over.Opponents in the Senate are now expected to slow-walk the legislation until May 26, when early voting begins for congressional primaries. If they can delay long enough, they may be able to kill the map for this election cycle entirely.That is how the Uniparty plays the game.And that is why Freedom Caucuses matter. They force fights the establishment wants to avoid. | MARYLAND The State Freedom Caucus strategy is not just legislative. It is electoral.This week, the Maryland Freedom Caucus endorsed conservative challenger Derek Howell against incumbent Republican Delegate Kevin Hornberger.Why? Because Hornberger’s record is not conservative by any honest measure.He voted for:⚡️ The Democrat budget⚡️ Green New Deal-style policies⚡️ Social justice mandates tied to SPLC-written frameworks used in Maryland schools No self-respecting conservative Republican should be voting for policies like these.The Maryland Freedom Caucus is making it clear that simply having an “R” next to your name is not enough. | OKLAHOMA If anyone still doubts Tyler Bowyer’s observation, look no further than Oklahoma.Republicans control the Oklahoma State Senate by a massive 40-8 margin. And yet, this week, legislation prohibiting illegal aliens from receiving Medicaid benefits failed by a vote of 14-32.Read that again.A conservative reform backed by the Oklahoma Freedom Caucus failed in a chamber dominated by Republicans.Why? Because liberal Republicans joined Democrats to kill it.The Oklahoma Freedom Caucus posted the final vote tally publicly (see below) so voters can see exactly who blocked the legislation.This is exactly why so many voters in deep red states feel betrayed.They elect Republicans expecting conservative governance and instead receive a watered-down version of Democrat policy. | RADIO CLIP OF THE WEEK In this week’s radio clip, South Carolina Freedom Caucus member April Cromer explains why South Carolina should already be a model state for President Trump’s policies. The problem, she says, is that Republican leadership routinely shares power with Democrats behind closed doors. 🎧 Subscribe on (or on your preferred podcast platform)📣 Follow us on X \- 🎵 Follow us on TikTok \- 👍 Follow us on Facebook \- | WE NEED YOUR HELP TO KEEP THE MOMENTUM The State Freedom Caucus Network exists for one reason: To build organized conservative coalitions inside state legislatures capable of defeating the Uniparty and delivering real results for voters.That work requires lawmakers willing to fight, grassroots activists willing to apply pressure, and supporters willing to help us expand this movement into more states.If you want to help us continue building that effort, please support our work today. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresidentState Freedom Caucus Network | |

name: Lauren Toncich, Turning Point USA
subject: This may be the most important fight right now
body:
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America’s youth.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Friend...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zna67chspr3mesot43g6q9dot61oef47rnqo3j98_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq75k9p5skud45rcvi2tlqtv7eo3d4occt2ffqno_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time.

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoombc4cj3qrl09vcek3a2e2u6j3upu8ejjfonqo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
_But here 's the problem, Friend... _

Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help.

Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare.

Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs.

**And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. **

_But there 's not much time left before the doors open... _

I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life...

That's why I'm personally asking:

**[Will you help sponsor a young woman to attend WLS with a gift of $50 today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpksk394i4rua9pk0m8ho2dbjslp4hhmnk0ah8t8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)**
---
[ **Sponsor a Student for WLS**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zidcgnm888o5v9ubccri2nj7q5k3259ngssntaj8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change.

The moment they realize they are NOT alone.

The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America.

The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for.

Because if we want to save this country...

**We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. **

That's the mission.

And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next.

Please help us make sure no young woman is left behind.

Let's fill San Antonio with women ready to LIVE boldly... Stand confidently in truth... LOVE AMERICA again...

And help WIN the American Culture War.
---
| | | **For Charlie,** **Lauren Toncich** Vice President of EventsTurning Point USA
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zte43i0418v7mcdpfk8h7gboh3pj2jqjj3fkagm0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
[ _**Support Turning Point USA**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgljn9hc5brod3qsivsnr4db9fuf99pvibopm2qo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)
---
**P.S.** The Left spent years convincing young women that faith, femininity, family, and patriotism were things to reject.

At the Women's Leadership Summit, thousands of women are rediscovering those values again.

**[Please help sponsor another young woman to join us in San Antonio for WLS this June-- and help build the next generation of fearless young women who will save this country.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlhsmcc8hi2em00h3h1nrupjhhmkedv2sgkbvgto_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s3jm0o77clh2bs)**

| Peter –

This is a long but important email about the fight to level the playing field in Virginia and stop President Trump’s power grab. I hope you’ll take a moment to read it, but if you’re short on time and already with me and Governor Spanberger in the fight to flip control of Congress, then please split a donation via the link below:

[_**https://united4va.org/20260515**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131452128/621156412/-921473510?refcode=BLU_EM_UFVF_2026-05-15_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjcwZDU3MzEtNmQ1MC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DhBrdM9uA1ebWbtjGTuIxT12CJ9kEOORYeisoNAzwCw=)

The Virginia Supreme Court just ruled with Republicans to overturn a free and fair referendum to redraw congressional districts in Virginia.

**So let's start with this: This is a major setback, but Virginia remains at the center of Democrats’ path towards flipping Congress.**

Virginia’s redistricting fight started because Republicans across the country decided to push mid-decade redistricting in states where they thought they could rig the map for partisan gain. Virginia’s effort was a response to that national power grab, not the cause of it.

Donald Trump assumed he could tilt the playing field and lock in political advantage before a single ballot was cast.

**Make no mistake: This decision is a huge victory for President Trump. The fight to flip control of Congress will not be easy,_but it never was going to be._**

And our work remains the same:

We will organize in every corner of Virginia. We will flood the airwaves with our message. We will make sure every Virginia voter knows exactly who ripped away their health care to give tax breaks to those at the very top, jeopardized their rural hospitals, and raised prices at the gas pump.

**In fact, I’ve looked at the numbers – and I firmly believe there is still a path for Democrats to flip multiple Congressional seats in Virginia this year. I’m determined to campaign just as hard for those districts as I will for my race.**

But that takes resources.

# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=117%2E127862%2EC20Nex)
The chaos coming out of Washington is hitting Nevada hard — reckless tariffs, threats to our voting rights, and higher prices everywhere we turn.
And through it all, MAGA Governor Joe Lombardo hasn’t stood up for us. He continues to cheer on Donald Trump, even as folks struggle here at home.
Nevada deserves better than a governor who stands on the sidelines. That’s why Aaron is running.
As Attorney General, he’s taken the Trump administration to court and won. He’s gone after scammers, corporate price gougers, and anyone trying to take advantage of Nevadans.
**As governor, Aaron will keep fighting for us. Because when Washington creates chaos, Nevada needs a leader who will stand in the way and protect our communities.**
But this is a toss-up race, and the only way we build a movement strong enough to defeat Lombardo and elect Aaron this November is with grassroots support.
**[Can you chip in today to elect a governor who will fight for the entirety of the Nevada family?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260515_1_ak.bRtHdl&amount=5&refcode=em20260515-117&t=2&akid=117%2E127862%2EC20Nex)**

Thank you,
Team Ford

**Doris Matsui still has over $1 million cash on hand, and the political establishment is going to spend heavily to protect the status quo and shut this movement down before it grows any bigger.**

Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051526_1&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We can win and protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051526_1&amount=35]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”

Now that they have the majority, they're doing whatever it takes to cater to Trump's desires ‐‐ even if it means cutting key programs like Medicaid and Social Security! It gets worse: EXPERTS ARE SAYING TAKING THE SENATE BACK WILL BE TOUGH. If we want to stop Trump's agenda, we'll NEED to take back the Senate ‐‐ but the analysts are saying it'll be an uphill battle. Factor in the Republican megadonors willing to spend hundreds of millions to keep the Senate red, and it's clear we won't have much margin for error. We can only beat the odds if grassroots Democrats like you step up. So please: We need your help to fight for the Senate. I know everyone is focused on the midterm elections in less than six months, and for good reason. | | It’s not hard to connect the dots: This administration is working to destroy Black political power and progress decades in the making. They have been unrelenting and coordinated in their attacks on Black workers, on Black bodies, on Black voters, on Black power, and Black progress. They’ve banned the words “Black,” “discrimination,” “minority,” and “racism” from federal documents. They’ve threatened educators teaching America’s true history and banned books written by Black authors. They’ve created an economy that has left Black unemployment at an all-time high — with Black women disproportionately pushed out of the workforce. They just eviscerated the Voting Rights Act to weaken our voting power. They’re attempting to pass the “SAVE” Act to make it even harder for us to vote. All the while — these Republicans quote John Lewis all the time. They quote Dr. King all the time. But they work actively to degrade their legacy and their work by trying to erase Black history, Black voters, Black progress, and Black people. It’s shameful and we must fight back. They cannot erase us — no matter how hard they try. While they come for our fundamental freedoms, I’ll continue leading the fight to litigate, legislate, organize, and mobilize for our full rights and citizenship. **It’s going to take the full strength of this grassroots community to keep our movement strong in the face of this unprecedented assault on our rights.** **[If you’re able to, can you make your first donation right now to fight back against these far-right attacks and protect the most marginalized? clean_body: It’s not hard to connect the dots | | | It’s not hard to connect the dots: This administration is working to destroy Black political power and progress decades in the making. They have been unrelenting and coordinated in their attacks on Black workers, on Black bodies, on Black voters, on Black power, and Black progress. They’ve banned the words “Black,” “discrimination,” “minority,” and “racism” from federal documents. They’ve threatened educators teaching America’s true history and banned books written by Black authors. They’ve created an economy that has left Black unemployment at an all-time high — with Black women disproportionately pushed out of the workforce. They just eviscerated the Voting Rights Act to weaken our voting power. They’re attempting to pass the “SAVE” Act to make it even harder for us to vote. All the while — these Republicans quote John Lewis all the time. They quote Dr. King all the time. But they work actively to degrade their legacy and their work by trying to erase Black history, Black voters, Black progress, and Black people. It’s shameful and we must fight back. They cannot erase us — no matter how hard they try. While they come for our fundamental freedoms, I’ll continue leading the fight to litigate, legislate, organize, and mobilize for our full rights and citizenship. body:

Derek — it’s Andie Levien. I’m writing to tell you about the work my team is doing to fight for you — and to ask you to [**chip in to the DNC today to help power that work.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-mid-month?amount=7&refcode=em_20260515_7136_fr&refcode2=7136_22930333_D9TlGr&akid=7136%2E22930333%2ED9TlGr) If you haven’t gotten an email from me yet, let me introduce myself: I’m the DNC’s General Counsel, which means it’s my job to oversee all of the DNC’s legal work, including taking Trump and his administration to court. Our team has worked to protect vote-by-mail access, to stop Trump from illegally obtaining unredacted voter rolls from states, and to defend the voting rights of hundreds of thousands of voters against Republican attacks. These days, I hear a lot of people worry about who could possibly stop Trump. I believe strongly that the _answer is all of us, together._ I want you to know that **_you’re not alone in this fight._** While the DNC is hard at work electing Democrats who will put a check on Trump’s power this November, our team of lawyers is working every day to uphold America’s most fundamental principles and mitigate the harm that the Trump administration can do in the meantime. **But if we want to win this fight, we need all hands on deck.** That means we need organizers on the ground knocking doors and registering voters. We need elected Democrats fighting back in their states — redistricting to counter Republican gerrymandering and passing policies to protect their constituents from the chaos and cruelty of the Trump administration. We need our best lawyers fighting in court to protect our civil rights. **And, maybe most importantly, we need _you_.** We need you to stay engaged, to continue paying attention even when things are bleak and scary. We need you to keep doing everything you can to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, across the country this year, and then we need you to help us do it again in 2028. **I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Congress in Ohio’s 10th District.** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/12663?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.15_Knickerbocker_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=4&akid=2276%2E259176%2E-0UESM) When I decided to run for Congress, it wasn’t because I’m a politician — because I’m not. I’m a nurse practitioner who's spent years sitting with patients in their hardest moments. A mom who worries about the world her kids will inherit. A veteran who believes that service doesn't end when you take off the uniform. I look at what’s happening in Ohio — families struggling to afford groceries, childcare costs through the roof, a congressman who's spent decades in Washington playing political games while the people he’s supposed to serve fell further behind. I knew I couldn't stay on the sidelines. So I got in the race. This campaign has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and we never will. Everything we've built has been powered by people, _by you._ And what we proved is that a grassroots movement can win. But this is not the finish line. It's the starting gun. Mike Turner is still in Washington. He still has the support of special interests and the GOP establishment behind him. And now he knows we're coming. Now we kick off the general election, and it will be _harder, louder, and more expensive_ than anything we've faced so far. But our mission is clear: flip OH-10 from red to blue, take back the House majority, and show Washington that working families won't be ignored anymore. **I’ve never walked away from a hard mission. Not in uniform. Not in scrubs. Not as a mom. body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2215%2E791427%2E6ggOyp)
Friend, I know you get a lot of emails like this from all kinds of folks in your inbox every day, so I’ll keep this short.
It’s no secret that this year has been extremely challenging for Minnesota and my Minneapolis community. But I am more energized than ever before to fight back and defeat the authoritarians in this corrupt administration.
Trump’s attacks, JD Vance’s lies, ICE’s brutality, the GOP’s sham investigations, the billionaires’ greed, the entire administration’s delusions and incompetence — none of this will stop us as long as we get organized and stand together in solidarity.
That’s why I’m hoping you will chip in just a few bucks to my campaign today. We’re at the halfway point of the month, and our fundraising is very far behind where we hoped it would be by now. And a slowdown in fundraising leads to a slowdown in our work.
So please: [**Chip in whatever you can afford today and help us get back on track. Let’s build a movement so powerful that it can defeat the far-right, put an end to their extreme agenda, and put our nation on the path towards a future where everyone can thrive.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260515-1-180&t=2&akid=2215%2E791427%2E6ggOyp)

In solidarity,
— Ilhan

subject: Holly (my dog) has been with me every time

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260515_HollyDexter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260515_HollyDexter_act]
Holly is my 10-year-old rescue pup, but if I’m being honest, she has given me more than I’ve given her.
She’s been by my side for so much—for the first Trump administration, long days at the hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, every one of my campaigns for office, and helping me adapt to a home without our children after sending them off to college.
No matter what happens in the world, Holly reminds me to slow down, stay grounded, and keep getting out for a walk.
Right now, people are feeling overwhelmed and uncertain about the future. I hear it everywhere I go. But in this election, we have a choice: whether we hold Donald Trump accountable and build the future we deserve, or allow him and his allies to keep eroding our democracy.
Last Friday, Holly (and Rob) walked with me to drop off my ballot once again—showing up for our families, our community, and our democracy—and she’ll be curled up beside me when the primary results come in Tuesday night.
If you believe in a government that actually represents all of us, now’s your chance to make your voice heard. Make a plan like ours to return your ballot by 8 PM on Tuesday, May 19th. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260515_HollyDexter_act]

clean_body: [] Holly is my 10-year-old rescue pup, but if I’m being honest, she has given me more than I’ve given her. She’s been by my side for so much—for the first Trump administration, long days at the hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, every one of my campaigns for office, and helping me adapt to a home without our children after sending them off to college. No matter what happens in the world, Holly reminds me to slow down, stay grounded, and keep getting out for a walk. Right now, people are feeling overwhelmed and uncertain about the future. I hear it everywhere I go. But in this election, we have a choice: whether we hold Donald Trump accountable and build the future we deserve, or allow him and his allies to keep eroding our democracy. Last Friday, Holly (and Rob) walked with me to drop off my ballot once again—showing up for our families, our community, and our democracy—and she’ll be curled up beside me when the primary results come in Tuesday night. If you believe in a government that actually represents all of us, now’s your chance to make your voice heard. Make a plan like ours to return your ballot by 8 PM on Tuesday, May 19th. When I was a boy in South Carolina, fewer than 1% of Black residents could vote. I know what it looks like when a government tries to silence voices and deny people their most basic rights. And it’s happening right now in South Carolina. body:
This recognition belongs to our members. | | | Peter, We are thrilled to announce that our very own Executive Director, Greisa Martínez Rosas, has been selected as part of the prestigious [TIME100 Philanthropy list](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.SEgofQhSb9pGg8bz5XQG3YudSZZDcftGld7--CwxVaL7YvT3H1wc9GAFGhz-_3n1pE7Z8ks4AYu3za7rQ3NIq7YAYN8w0LiWgN31WhdAKN3B1aARO5wQqZMUY_aLZfO8kgVBjcBH10gvqy5uRBne8A0GvaRttrkemJ95ByfqhdNFFpDkiZPVtBMTSbrq-rHYyyK8WtbQxGjIBkmtpVmaWgdWsIGChPJ0MlyPZ9CCjJebwkZiR9r0wcjDF6InuOyBD4biOvMA3XbGDpZTmgtLCdTfHQDlfzbUiYG3vT_vlVSt6XZgGhXRBoarRcyfXGve2OVuUFQbMzOpZVH8mtW9uwTl5UySzj3AVyflko3USmHZA2nSzTJUKN_gxHdqHhFoYAT7kLFDKxmWG8LdTwwH-MmXiLXpeb3dEf6lVewxJEiL1rfzUfpW8S5I6qxHvHrV2ziDb2o5NJWQgSNbrrAWng/4qn/vZ_kQHEdQ9uYy0kVCmKsVg/h0/h001.4cVR2howN_Ulogn36bl5U8sLr24ICNQPb-0HjxwPtns), recognizing the most influential leaders across the country who are shaping the future of giving! Describing Greisa Martínez Rosas, TIME wrote: “Greisa Martínez Rosas is an ‘unafraid’ and ‘unashamed’ immigrant who arrived in the U.S. as a child, and she brings that lived experience to her role at the helm of United We Dream. Martínez Rosas has emerged as a vocal thought leader, often drawing from her own personal background, including the deaths of both her parents. **_‘That loss has made me as audacious as I can be, because there’s nothing that anyone can do to me that will hurt as much as that grief,’_** she says. But she’s heartened to know that a formerly ‘undocumented, poor, queer girl from Texas can be part of a social movement that mobilizes millions of dollars.’” **This honor isn’t Greisa’s alone. It’s a testament to the vision, brilliance, and leadership of immigrant youth who are organizing every day, redefining how this country thinks about who belongs, and demonstrating in practice what it means to show up for each other in times of crisis.** This recognition belongs to our 1.2 million members and to the leader we have entrusted United We Dream with. **[If you’re inspired by what we’ve accomplished together and believe in what we can continue to build, will you donate to United We Dream today? Describing Greisa Martínez Rosas, TIME wrote: “Greisa Martínez Rosas is an ‘unafraid’ and ‘unashamed’ immigrant who arrived in the U.S. as a child, and she brings that lived experience to her role at the helm of United We Dream. Martínez Rosas has emerged as a vocal thought leader, often drawing from her own personal background, including the deaths of both her parents. **_‘That loss has made me as audacious as I can be, because there’s nothing that anyone can do to me that will hurt as much as that grief,’_** she says. But she’s heartened to know that a formerly ‘undocumented, poor, queer girl from Texas can be part of a social movement that mobilizes millions of dollars.’” **This honor isn’t Greisa’s alone. clean_body: This recognition belongs to our members. | | | Peter, We are thrilled to announce that our very own Executive Director, Greisa Martínez Rosas, has been selected as part of the prestigious , recognizing the most influential leaders across the country who are shaping the future of giving! Describing Greisa Martínez Rosas, TIME wrote: “Greisa Martínez Rosas is an ‘unafraid’ and ‘unashamed’ immigrant who arrived in the U.S. as a child, and she brings that lived experience to her role at the helm of United We Dream. Martínez Rosas has emerged as a vocal thought leader, often drawing from her own personal background, including the deaths of both her parents. ‘That loss has made me as audacious as I can be, because there’s nothing that anyone can do to me that will hurt as much as that grief,’ she says. But she’s heartened to know that a formerly ‘undocumented, poor, queer girl from Texas can be part of a social movement that mobilizes millions of dollars.’” This honor isn’t Greisa’s alone. It’s a testament to the vision, brilliance, and leadership of immigrant youth who are organizing every day, redefining how this country thinks about who belongs, and demonstrating in practice what it means to show up for each other in times of crisis. This recognition belongs to our 1.2 million members and to the leader we have entrusted United We Dream with. body:
Help us fund the next wave of voter registration →
#
Peter,
If you knew that your **$3** donation could help register eligible voters before the big midterm election, which will be decided by a razor-thin margin...[**would you make that donation right now?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260515-1-ak.MjOstW&amount=3&%3Brefcode=em20260515-137&t=1&akid=137%2E1366028%2ECtidEZ)
_It’s true._
Your donation of **$3** or any amount you can contribute goes a long way in helping us register voters in battleground districts and states that will determine control of the House and Senate.
At Voto Latino, we know _exactly_ what it takes to register someone — and make sure they turn out to vote.

Dear friend,
I am pro-worker, pro-union, and pro-family.
That’s why one of the first bills I’ll fight for in Congress is the PRO Act, legislation that would protect workers’ right to organize, strengthen collective bargaining, and help bring good-paying manufacturing jobs back to Michigan’s 10th District.
Working people built Michigan’s middle class. But right now, corporate interests and D.C. insiders are chipping away at workers’ rights while good-paying jobs disappear.
We can change that if we elect leaders on the side of workers, not billionaires. That’s why I don’t take corporate PAC money and why I need your support right now to win. Will you chip in $25 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260515_FirstThing_act&amount=25]
CHIP IN TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260515_FirstThing_act&amount=25]
Families across Michigan’s 10th Congressional District are working harder than ever while CEOs and union-busters pocket the profits and ship jobs overseas.
More than 60 million Americans want the chance to join a union.
We need leaders who will stand with them instead of corporations, who will protect union rights instead of attacking them, and who will rebuild an economy that rewards hard work again. We cannot afford to keep letting politicians in D.C. side with corporate special interests over working families.
This fight is personal for me: I was a union member my entire career. I know what these jobs and the ability to fight for workers mean for families, for neighborhoods, and for the future of communities across Michigan.

| | | | | | Team Mackenzie,Our campaign remains committed to our record of delivering results for our communities. This week I want to highlight a group that is especially important to me: the women of PA-7.Throughout my time in office, I’ve been committed to supporting the needs of women and families. That includes addressing health care needs for women by authoring legislation that established Pennsylvania’s maternal mortality review committee. It also means delivering relief for parents by permanently expanding the child tax credit, improving access to childcare, and supporting paid family leave.**That’s why I am proud to announce the launch of our Women for Mackenzie coalition** — dedicated to highlighting the needs, concerns, and priorities of women across our district. This coalition is led by leaders who have already contributed so much to our communities, and we’re grateful for their support of our community.

| Letter from the Chair
---
Onward to the General Election
Nebraska's May 12 primary is now in the books, and the post-election analysis is everywhere. For political junkies, the Monday morning quarterbacking has not been in short supply.
Turnout hit a historic low--just 27% statewide, down from 34% in 2022. Yet the Nebraskans who did vote delivered strong, clear results for conservative leadership. Incumbents including Governor Jim Pillen and U.S. Senator Pete Ricketts secured the GOP nod.
And in the biggest story of the night, Scott Petersen delivered a decisive upset over two-term incumbent Secretary of State Bob Evnen, revealing that election confidence is a persistent issue among Nebraska voters. Social media lit up with celebration from conservatives who see this as a grassroots win for restoring trust in our elections, while Petersen himself stated: "It's time to bring the party together and now we are going to be a true MAGA state."
A heartfelt hat tip to every candidate who ran and didn't advance -- I know firsthand how these races feel. After running and losing a Douglas County Commissioner race in 2016, I remember the sting, even when you know the math and the map aren't on your side. But here's what I learned: the experience is never wasted. Door-knocking humbles you, and listening to your neighbors' real struggles changes how you see every future race. The anonymous trolls and keyboard warriors are brutal, but their public jabs at your character force you to decide what's worth your time -- and what isn't.
As a candidate, your effort mattered. You built relationships, sharpened conservative ideas, and stayed engaged. Stay in the fight. There are countless ways to serve--local party work, issue advocacy, supporting the ticket. Keep those doors open and those relationships strong.
To our winners heading into the general election--congratulations! The real work starts now. Review the primary numbers, refine your message, and tighten your ground game. There's time for a quick breather, but not much of one.
We need to address how to counter our candidates being out funded. A wealthy few within Nebraska and many outside our state are funding the Democrats through ActBlue and their NGO networks. How can we best work together to re-engage our donor base and to amplify our limited resources?
For the rest of us in party leadership and supportive roles--volunteers, donors, activists--we have the same task. Study the map. Prioritize our limited resources. And above all, bring every candidate team and every faction of our party together. Cohesion and cooperation are the critical components that lead to victory.
Nebraskans didn't turn out in big numbers for the primary, but we can give them a powerful reason to vote in November. The gap between proven Republican principles and radical Democrat policies has never been wider. From open borders and soft-on-crime extremism to attacks on parental rights and Nebraska values, the contrast is stark.
Let's keep the Good Life in Nebraska--strong families, safe communities, secure elections, and opportunity for all. Onward to victory in November!

In Liberty and in Truth, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party
