---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone!
🚨 NEW KEYNOTE ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨
During National Police Week, RMV Freedom Festival is proud to announce that **DOG THE BOUNTY HUNTER** will serve as the keynote speaker for the Back the Blue Bash this June in Castle Rock.
Known worldwide for his television career, fugitive recovery work, and advocacy for public safety, Duane Chapman has become one of America’s most recognizable voices supporting law enforcement, accountability, and redemption.
🔥 BACK THE BLUE BASH KEYNOTE
🇺🇸 DOG THE BOUNTY HUNTER
🎟️ **[Tickets are live now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** Join us June 26–27 in Castle Rock.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, May 13, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Weiser’s record: The special prosecution paradox](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
When a serial killer was working his way through the San Luis Valley, Anne Kelly’s eight-lawyer office needed help. She didn’t call the Attorney General.
“That case was certainly a prime case for which the attorney general’s office could have assisted,” said Kelly, the 12th Judicial District DA whose office covers six rural counties in southern Colorado. “Instead, the Boulder County District Attorney’s Office sent a crew of people upon the request of the district attorney and handled that case from start to finish. And that was really the only reason why that case was as successful as it was.”
The case was against Adre Baroz, known as “Psycho,” sentenced in May 2024 for five murders in the San Luis Valley. He is serving five life sentences plus 140 years. Boulder went. The AG’s Special Prosecution Unit didn’t.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[“Stay on our necks”: DPS board adopts immigration policy proposed by activist coalition](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY NOTARFRANCESCO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Denver school board adopts new limits on cooperation with ICE:** Denver Public Schools unanimously approved a policy restricting interactions with federal immigration authorities, including limits on sharing student information and access to school property.
* **Activist coalition played major role in shaping policy:** The amendment was pushed by a coalition of more than 40 organizations led by Movimiento Poder, with board members openly acknowledging coordination with activist groups and suspending the normal policy review process to fast-track approval.
* **Critics raise concerns about political influence and public accountability:** The article highlights ties between coalition groups and anti-ICE, anti-police, and socialist activist movements, while questioning whether outside political organizations are exerting growing influence over policies in Colorado’s largest school district.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!

|

**[He flagged the DEI language. He filed the report anyway. Colorado fired him for both.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Colorado agriculture employee fired after raising concerns over DEI grant language:** Former plant health programs manager Rich Guggenheim says the Colorado Department of Agriculture terminated him after he flagged DEI-related training language tied to a federally funded USDA report and later filed whistleblower complaints.

* **Dispute centers on use of federal funds and reporting requirements:** Guggenheim argued federal dollars had already been used for the DEI-related training and questioned why the state focused on removing language from reports rather than addressing the spending itself.

* **State faces accusations of retaliation and lack of transparency:** Guggenheim has appealed his firing, claiming retaliation for protected whistleblower activity, while the department declined to answer questions about the grant funding, reporting process, or whether similar DEI language remains in future USDA reporting templates.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Dillon Vakoff died protecting a family. His mother and his fellow officer won’t let Colorado forget why.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY GABE EVANS & LISA VAKOFF | COMMENTARY | MAY 13** _In 2025, 115 police officers in the United States paid the ultimate price. Officers who survive their careers carry lifelong scars and health complications. The average American experiences their first heart attack at the average age of 65. Police officers get their first heart attack at age 46. Stress, lack of sleep, and violent criminals are just a few of the hazards that cops face every day._
__
**[Three GOP candidates take aim at Colorado’s open primary law—and bring the math](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY CANDICE STRUTZREIM | COMMENTARY | MAY 13** _Republican candidates Ron Hanks (CD-3), David Willson (attorney general) and Scott Bottoms (governor) have filed a lawsuit to challenge the constitutionality of CRS 1-7-201. Also known as the Open Primary statute, the law was created through Proposition 108 in 2016. The hearing will be held in Denver District Court this Thursday at 1:30 pm, one day before primary ballots are scheduled to be sent to overseas and military voters for the June 30 election._
__

**[“Regardless of party”: Colorado’s teacher unions say one thing. A decade of records shows another.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MAY 13** _Colorado teachers are Republicans. They are Democrats. They are unaffiliated. They work in every county in the state, in every kind of classroom, for every kind of family. Their union says its political spending reflects that same range. The money says something else._ __

name: AOC
subject: Yes, a tiny amount of people can make billions of dollars. And millions of everyday Americans are bearing the cost.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Someone can certainly _make_ a billion dollars. That’s not the same thing as _earning_.
Growing fast and disrupting markets also often means chasing and wielding market power, political influence, and scale.
Take Airbnb. They heavily lobby politicians against passing housing laws to protect working class residents because it’s bad for their business model.
Airbnb could not exist at its current scale and size without the housing market destabilizations, displacements, and exploits that are supercharging the evictions of working people everywhere from Puerto Rico to Jackson Hole.
**Now, young people are planning for a future where they will never be able to afford to own a home** — while others have twenty, and live off renting them at extortionate rates with zero protections.

clean_body: I've enclosed our latest campaign update on the status of this critical runoff election. Please Read: | MESSAGE FROM CHIP ROY Let me be direct. Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. That didn't happen by accident. It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll. My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." They thought they could buy Texas.They were wrong. The runoff election is May 26 - less than three weeks away - and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale. But let's be honest about what's at stake. This is no time to hand the Attorney General's office to someone who's never set foot in a courtroom. Texas is facing serious challenges: a wide-open border, foreign adversaries buying up our land, and a radical agenda determined to reshape our state and our country. We need a proven conservative who knows how to fight - and win. The Attorney General isn't a ceremonial role. It's the chief legal officer of the largest conservative state in America. It requires leadership from day one—building a strong legal team, enforcing the law without hesitation, and taking the fight wherever it's needed to defend Texas. I'm ready to do that. But I need to know if conservatives like you are in this fight with me. Between now and May 26th, I'll be working around the clock to make sure Texans understand exactly what's on the line in this runoff. Let's finish this. If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
On a recent visit to Brown University, I asked students, “How many of you are worried about getting a job?” Every hand went up.
When I asked why, the answer was unanimous: artificial intelligence.
The AI revolution could help Americans work smarter and be more productive than ever before. Yet big corporations like Meta, Amazon, and Oracle are cutting thousands of jobs while reporting record profits.
To meet this moment, we need the boldest jobs agenda in generations. That’s why I’ve introduced the Work for America program. This plan would create over one million living-wage jobs across a range of occupations and train young people to take on high-paying AI-era jobs. Inspired by FDR’s Works Progress Administration, which critically boosted our economy after the Great Depression, this is a jobs plan built for the 21st century.
I’ve broken down what Work for America does, how it works, and how we pay for it in a new piece for the Wall Street Journal [https://www.wsj.com/opinion/wpa-meets-ai-in-my-work-for-america-proposal-3e02295c?st=aJN7y2&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink].

The Vision Problem No Prescription Can Fix | | | [](https://links.newsletter.marketdailypro.com/u/click?_t=7a28bbb892d5463fb7f7674bdc2d44f2&_m=88dbb9cd3ef4485f9b3ddb492bdb6003&_e=RTS-miUwyqE4qqms0BI9mGAuOAUywKeHKzDkHjBmsuNchuBVSIRw7gElozi577PJbrLALD_cHSBrgmrbec58A5Sridw9vDlJ3LTyW70Y2b1GlApnzkhmzcOUJV3hgWkDcEDznyhMfYROw3TplmprExARTSDI2cpYvlpTmzOMid7K3yLnhl2why7FA7K_RJgXb61hBRSaU3EITPqsYdOCLXb_1MulN65IsB1xnr-3jkP8Sx1U7dkO0cyRVmQKFq2yYEdn5dJ5UJictdk92_0dXN78Eh3LLwWjFSKOM8u22Hm49ihDj3qlpsOaTkL9xQ4sFkOacNGvpH9qKOCoSahPXQ%3D%3D)

| | | | |

Think your glasses are protecting your eyes?

Think again.

A growing number of optometrists now say the **real cause of vision loss** isn’t how the eye _sees_ — it’s how the **retina sends signals** to your brain.

body:
I just breathed a sigh of relief

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131479293/621240501/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzc1NzFiYy05ODUwLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IYqt3o4Pr8odxDRxjHcOExmfLvu-KvXmaJEFUMnSLYE=)

Peter, I just breathed a sigh of relief, and I wanted to share the good news with you.

On May 1st, a 5th Circuit Court of Appeals judge in Louisiana issued a ruling that would have banned the mailing and shipping of Mifepristone after telehealth appointments, throwing providers across the country into chaos and putting one of the most accessible forms of reproductive care at risk. When the Supreme Court issued a temporary block on May 4th, it offered _some_ relief, but still had our nation in a cloud of uncertainty.

**That's why I'm so happy to tell you that yesterday, the Supreme Court just ruled to protect the mailing and shipping of Mifepristone after telehealth appointments while litigation continues. **

Here in Iowa, we already know what it's like to live under severe abortion restrictions, and I was dreading our people losing even _more access_ to reproductive healthcare. **This is a win for our rights, but we can't ignore that Iowans are already drowning in a crisis manufactured by Mariannette Miller-Meeks and her Rolodex of anti-woman, anti-science shills.**

Over and over again, Miller-Meeks has loudly cheered against her constituents' reproductive freedoms. From co-sponsoring a national total abortion ban without exceptions to voting to ensure the Iowa State Constitution does not protect abortion — **she helped pave the way for the near-total ban our state is living under today.**

Thanks to her, experts reported that in 2024, the number of Iowans forced to travel out of state for abortion care rose by 182%. Doctors across Iowa are still navigating legal risks when trying to treat patients facing dangerous pregnancy complications. Families are being put in situations no one should have to face.

And through all of it, instead of acknowledging the harm or working toward solutions, _she has consistently made things worse for women and families._

_This is damning,_ Peter. For more than half a century, _Roe v. Wade_ stood as settled law because it protected both the patients' reproductive choices and the doctors caring for them. Since the Supreme Court took it upon itself to rip away this fundamental freedom, the American people have been at the mercy of partisans like Mariannette Miller-Meeks and her political agenda.

clean_body: I just breathed a sigh of relief | = Peter, I just breathed a sigh of relief, and I wanted to share the good news with you. On May 1st, a 5th Circuit Court of Appeals judge in Louisiana issued a ruling that would have banned the mailing and shipping of Mifepristone after telehealth appointments, throwing providers across the country into chaos and putting one of the most accessible forms of reproductive care at risk. When the Supreme Court issued a temporary block on May 4th, it offered some relief, but still had our nation in a cloud of uncertainty. That's why I'm so happy to tell you that yesterday, the Supreme Court just ruled to protect the mailing and shipping of Mifepristone after telehealth appointments while litigation continues. Here in Iowa, we already know what it's like to live under severe abortion restrictions, and I was dreading our people losing even more access to reproductive healthcare. This is a win for our rights, but we can't ignore that Iowans are already drowning in a crisis manufactured by Mariannette Miller-Meeks and her Rolodex of anti-woman, anti-science shills. Over and over again, Miller-Meeks has loudly cheered against her constituents' reproductive freedoms. From co-sponsoring a national total abortion ban without exceptions to voting to ensure the Iowa State Constitution does not protect abortion — she helped pave the way for the near-total ban our state is living under today. Thanks to her, experts reported that in 2024, the number of Iowans forced to travel out of state for abortion care rose by 182%. Doctors across Iowa are still navigating legal risks when trying to treat patients facing dangerous pregnancy complications. Families are being put in situations no one should have to face. And through all of it, instead of acknowledging the harm or working toward solutions, she has consistently made things worse for women and families. This is damning, Peter. For more than half a century, Roe v. Wade stood as settled law because it protected both the patients' reproductive choices and the doctors caring for them. Since the Supreme Court took it upon itself to rip away this fundamental freedom, the American people have been at the mercy of partisans like Mariannette Miller-Meeks and her political agenda. = If ## Boy, 8, Helps Stop Plane from Being Diverted
An 8-year-old boy from England prevented a plane from being diverted after spending more than three hours [calming a disruptive passenger](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ_GdLMyA4a9hYttkFLctCnRgMfgXf8g2wHt20cb5Q3SHelIR-f7fn3P3-S8i9tPCqztZudq0xz5Kp5r5TwHZ8jlg2nlQC_OW6ZoApVjRokDSAWtmg05_577xmjLjNw1rNtxvN9H1ePQ7Jp6tRKj-WpxpC-5ohoGNh2qpbNqXZbG6c-aVK1CKbu-v43KSCIeiYaBluUuesnG1ZRvz-Ri3dn6dzo539YUGq_3Wo8iuofASeB0XdctlPjpBE4cYVsETh8ogdPv179wUCkcN84FCp1swOYU4MkVwXq37RWMOzkXlyLUneKrQE2wc06wpDfcgaKB3RUwZAROlOHxQGx_5NJkbY7Lee_KMIpeboGc__u0_rfiU-OfAAAA__-ywpO1) mid-flight.

Phoenix Rose and his father, James, were flying home from Turkey on a Jet2 flight when a woman began shouting and swearing after being caught drinking her own alcohol on board. After the crew warned the flight could be diverted, James asked a flight attendant if he could try to help. The crew agreed, and the woman was seated between the father and son. [Phoenix took over](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu4yAUAL_G7ogwxuAUFNuky7ZbooM5OGeXl4BNlL-_yv2FW480I82fu70DRcrnb0howhnsCMVmfPWIY2CziTxQqwgHJviH7WyQfYJereBCMb6xZbMeKL6tnL0JiALXGc2i9b7rTQo1P8yKPAi3H84taj8kOoRVyesBwXO58jCT-dj4tmyC81XKi948B0ANoBQ4t0-So6dR2uVvoTweGOK7PLFdjpLmaB5j1D6tvyZxm8StYqkRP2gSt5258mZ9lNpZjZCRHRAT5ZN56u1_HfREVqF3zCc2tixXpbS6zs34-qIYqSs9SX4moPhdGz_e9DTiKwAA__8NJn80) from there, singing to the woman, showing her his football cards, and gently tapping her arm whenever she started to escalate. "_Don't shout, don't swear,_ " he told her. "_What do your kids do?_ " It worked. The woman stayed calm for the rest of the flight. The pilot shook their hands upon landing, and Jet2 gifted them free flights. Then strangers across the U.K., Germany, and the Netherlands began [sending presents to their home](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQAL8GOiOzGGwKF6-hy2uvRAteYBMbI9uXKH9_yv3CdVPNSPN1m2_Ins_9Pway277NZYvzSa_sqRRKc2CHnC7ClQI-KO0JTxcwXzNIGITsRdvPDtm_Z1U7uxEBdTXZVmtjdK9gqA-7GtOD7rp2GwHMCFrB2mky42jUYAzUbD822bc9SNkp1ejeSUTSiMOAy2IqJclxiam5Rz7LQZt_xyelZo2h9vYo5cpV96-CqYJpSVyWxLQ1a2y-HxVMa-JAFUxX9Lx-YIlvYUQu8criTgWE4yelzPEULy6HePDpTsq5OUrwdbLuerH3nAddKbkHZP9bLn9e9rTwEwAA__8q4IIv), including a PlayStation 5.
## Firefighter Reunites with Graduate
When Chloe Huddle walked across the stage at [Grand Canyon University](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uhDAQBOCnMZ2RMdjcFS7S0F3alGiN12YT86PF3OnePiKvkHakGX2ar8f4AMq0pk9Y0MUUxxK3ccXXkbEU5HGhAMQ7woQL_CAnhjUscOyjVtpKZWRjxgCU32NXBRcRNbYVuqbvb7fedNpWswNrvTLemIheTfcY2sZ725k2Qn83pq3IXWvKNEYr1XZd3ZugALAHsBa8v4lOYaCycf290VpmjPm9PZHraVuq7OZS9kO0H0IPQg8Xv07TWWM4hR7SdMorEnqIxBgpzQVZevBvOaMMmOmJjEEynisVlHFjOSPLq5gYwgmFtlXooWIX9hflTIftRafSApT_COXf3z2d_g0AAP__o7aHFw) to receive her degree in educational studies, one of the loudest cheers came from the retired firefighter who helped bring her into the world 22 years earlier. Alan Kent responded to a medical call in Colorado Springs on Feb. 15, 2004, and [delivered baby Chloe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u2zAQBODTUB0NesUfu2CRRt1Lm1JYiUtqE0o0KNqCcvpAucLrphh8GMyvr_ELOfOWfuJKPqY4tljGjY49U2tUx5UDcn0RzrTiH6qp4hZW3F8jKLBSGXk3Y0DO56i74CMRUN-Rvzv3eDijwXaLD9Y5oKcmrefYAz3nWUVnptk-bR_svWN_acrcDSjVa31zJihEcojW4jQ9hFYUuJV6-114awvFfJYP1dtc1i77pbXXLvofAgYBw3EcN_wbceV8XgUBw8ULGJS-shEwRK4UOS2NqjyWIgNl_lClICecTgkgT8K6S0xFYmu0hV0uVGWa3zJVDG9sXDYBQ1d9eB2cM-_WCa3Sipz_z2rf_vPj4V8AAAD__676i7I) at the family's home that morning. He was the first person to hold her.

Weeks later, her mother brought Chloe to Fire Station 15 to say thank you, and the two families made a pact: Chloe would celebrate birthdays at the station, and Alan would be there for her major milestones. They've kept that promise ever since. Alan, now retired after 35 years in the fire service, traveled 800 miles from Colorado to Phoenix for the ceremony. "_Even if I wasn't retired, I[wouldn't miss this](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OnDAURVcDnUe2wQYKF2mm-9KmRA_eNbzE_Mg4M2L30SRLSH2vjo7Oj6_xiyTJvnynDSEucSzxGHe8r4RSkMdNmCSfoBkb_UJeMu280XWOVluvtFPGjUyS7rGtOUTAoqkRTNf1feda6-s1GO8bilPsG9P308yY9QxrWzN55h5DLeFD0844q3XTto_OsSZCR-Q9TVNftRos5ciPn4fsZUVM9_FCfszHVqewlnJeVfOtss_KPk8cZ8JnquwzSkaUZS3IakU6wYqR5IWsSE003cpadYPypRL9OykqBTuD1Yqslkz8m4ocuzJmcINzQ50Dn29JSS7fVa1eNpL0V6X8d8NXsH8CAAD__-24iUM)_," he said. He's also on the guest list for Chloe's wedding this summer.
## Goats Aid in Family Rescue
Two pet goats named Percy and Penny helped rescuers [locate a family trapped](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI4cYxtSuNiGLttuiQZmTGZjMDKTRPn7p-QXXn2lq3POv-t4Bc68LX9hpZiWNEoq40avI5MI1XFlBK47wUwr3KkuFTZc4dhHa2zQxuuzHxE4v0fXYExEltqG4rnr-r7zzobmFlvfAQGGC_lpavuQZht8spfJOT9fJmw4ft6MP3trTOvcqfNoAKgDCAGmqVfOELKUevpfeJMbpfwuT6qnuaxNjjeR_VDtH2UHZYd7Kt9B2eFjouyQywxZ2WGiXJ6EeifRSwE59PJgJF3pmB9UDy1FS4V9J9QJVs5vDUmoatoYtZS6ARZlh6ZG3F-cMx-hU84sK3D-ssivIz6j_QkAAP__rGuKmA) in their storm cellar after an EF4 tornado destroyed their home in Enid, Oklahoma. The Sloat family had taken shelter as the storm hit, but heavy debris sealed the cellar door shut. The family feared their goats hadn't survived. The plywood shelter they'd built for Percy and Penny had completely vanished. Friend, In the two weeks since the Supreme Court’s ruling that dismantled the Voting Rights Act, right-wing state leaders across the South have taken swift action to disenfranchise Black voters. **Tennessee’s GOP lawmakers were the first to redraw and pass a new, racist congressional district map. It eliminates the state’s only majority-Black and majority-Democratic district.** The new District 9 puts part of Memphis into a majority-white district that stretches over 100 miles across the state. **Tennessee State Representative Justin J. Pearson has been running to represent District 9 in the U.S. Congress, and he’s not backing down now.** Neither should we. [**We won’t let white supremacists take away our power. Let’s fight back against Jim Crow 2.0 by sending Justin J. Pearson to Congress. Please split a donation of $5 between Justin’s campaign and my re-election campaign today.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJYfeF5pb3177AzOGP-JyXDqnDnm1J_BdEupV8hZjrblqhIy4RgXulfxp9pgRC_ewm_fvnspWWQ4-nwSqm05I0RBLTR8BWN--PKgzG8cypL-0SEBEt2gdL6N-xZFfIUhPR3j2Sm2ZNNuavuUhrmDn4TNggviLUQMsg4SM9Impp0iBMLfV-ER4cEJbYxsaeOH2-2PGva0Gu9l6mYrRJH2nLj8GOpZZGZLDbqEDF4ztGgctIZB-t6CFQnKoGJ_XFkJVkpfNp6rzsvqO2o5aFXlitVym3HHnA3YxRYtBph-uhEMUDxCMAtEahIqzJRtB1sxkdkcW3vnJushjl_1ITFUfYMy2VkU9BQNbs2eP4pENT9X4eqB8r9YhTR90Ivtt5jPG9/4qn/BEn5ioFdRI6mnQUZNLSs9g/h1/h001.gJOg_FMj8p91OArnruhAcf5f_SufKJL9cmlV4YHOYuY) | [CHIP IN TO FIGHT JIM CROW 2.0](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJYfeF5pb3177AzOGP-JyXDqnDnm1J_BdEupV8hZjrblpCzz5w4O8M1u0vvBLETBuyRkG1IhHVPSfxXplvoXlVfNRQjlrlrw---Gs9OPCoZXBi4piBbuerigunXbG2EOnj__qocLD-AWlpLqS2NYJVsBsNIU1JerMxMomZnLSp0wcdSsMuuPA297qFAl38HwqFIVwnzwFOl-xieURc8ynGnRfTvX-i8SiJduyqEqTRNQ2o-jqRA6ix1igIgrXyaN38_0dnu2Bo1aq98mhELJxzdr3ginTEguRKOfNvsTcX4ww4mSF1ufFD3Yv4WR2W551h0WKAy06-AajN2VLT1LbzGYPkMnZ6oDfMBbNt9HUBQgMuUi07lLTqNpSJAK2VHuqV/4qn/BEn5ioFdRI6mnQUZNLSs9g/h2/h001.ONfr1_WXpmYNRSj9jEpvEStBzBOaEmesKtSBq1NIDUw)

Justin reminds us that this isn’t the end. As our ancestors have, we will keep working toward justice and equity for all, because this is our country and this fight affects all of us.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJYfeF5pb3177AzOGP-JyXDqnDnm1J_BdEupV8hZjrblqVbILrw3U5arPrEQl9a0e8-2xGnwc0ngbxZgf5HMjAfMQF3Xe_2OX-17bAIeSpq34E1SJ4TPTHTt-35f-DOMt_MU8hA5jx1_TlsC3AyK-4PUjLbSHOupzwMASZGNpKmuWygiIUXpt1U0AXuF01MwUK4Gd0lNT8LhA6QKGbbIn2ZdnoRj2pQcL_rkfw8Vw0xjHFXcRyDtuRM4o0dohOBJx9m36mh7zksTZkUCMRAfXOR-L6DgP8pdVotm8o52_hJJvNNcDlYmJWLCxmgAjBqWe8tBc_yL6ys3PehBc9Z_x04u3jaivxgME7Lg5DtzlrYCUuiLTpoc-zJzXWn1G2s8PW/4qn/BEn5ioFdRI6mnQUZNLSs9g/h3/h001.MZbYapdEVAPBe_TGD7Y_Dk4etcGzP4Eova4wlnitW1w)

After demanding action to stop gun violence a few years ago, Justin and his Black colleague were unfairly expelled from the State House—but the white colleague who joined them was not.
Justin didn’t back down then. In a landslide, he won a special election to take back his seat and led legislative fights for gun control, a higher minimum wage, and expanded voting rights and healthcare coverage. He also **passed legislation to monitor corporate polluters**.
The co-founder of the environmental justice organization Memphis Community Against Pollution, **Justin has also led and won fights against billion-dollar oil companies**.

subject: We cannot surrender young women to the Left
body:
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Friend...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkb2q3DAQhZ9G7ryMZFs_hYvA4u6mCIGUZlYae8W1JEc_WfL2wZd9gbTnfHwwc359rB_oDx_37xhoznVbc1lfZDHGVEvLmaKj_De1uL9SWAUI2cPU8-nieOdmZx1y29HMldJaKVCie86jnYZp0kobbhCksrgZLgRIqQUXmjo_XyqY-CRg4GBuIxHZh9HO4CalQTYCHpTrLdPZHoe3GCuWzy1lSzebQnfMz1rPwoZvTCxMLIVsy3TDSC7Vi2BiqS1HH_f-TD7WvhVkYjGjBjNK1RuzPfrRSOj1NkEPhM4i0DbyjQ1Lq2GtlAMb7j9-LhwGqQwT8ooDOd-uggL64x2W1LIlNtyfmB2WzxXt73dlMZzo98iGez1bwa8vrq-jdHl258sfhy9SsRH2y_d1XP3_Kf7M4l8AAAD__8QGluU)
---
I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkb2q3DAQhZ9G7ryMZFs_hYvA4u6mCIGUZlYae8W1JEc_WfL2wZd9gbTnfHwwc359rB_oDx_37xhoznVbc1lfZDHGVEvLmaKj_De1uL9SWAUI2cPU8-nieOdmZx1y29HMldJaKVCie86jnYZp0kobbhCksrgZLgRIqQUXmjo_XyqY-CRg4GBuIxHZh9HO4CalQTYCHpTrLdPZHoe3GCuWzy1lSzebQnfMz1rPwoZvTCxMLIVsy3TDSC7Vi2BiqS1HH_f-TD7WvhVkYjGjBjNK1RuzPfrRSOj1NkEPhM4i0DbyjQ1Lq2GtlAMb7j9-LhwGqQwT8ooDOd-uggL64x2W1LIlNtyfmB2WzxXt73dlMZzo98iGez1bwa8vrq-jdHl258sfhy9SsRH2y_d1XP3_Kf7M4l8AAAD__8QGluU)
---
Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time.

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkb2q3DAQhZ9G7ryMZFs_hYvA4u6mCIGUZlYae8W1JEc_WfL2wZd9gbTnfHwwc359rB_oDx_37xhoznVbc1lfZDHGVEvLmaKj_De1uL9SWAUI2cPU8-nieOdmZx1y29HMldJaKVCie86jnYZp0kobbhCksrgZLgRIqQUXmjo_XyqY-CRg4GBuIxHZh9HO4CalQTYCHpTrLdPZHoe3GCuWzy1lSzebQnfMz1rPwoZvTCxMLIVsy3TDSC7Vi2BiqS1HH_f-TD7WvhVkYjGjBjNK1RuzPfrRSOj1NkEPhM4i0DbyjQ1Lq2GtlAMb7j9-LhwGqQwT8ooDOd-uggL64x2W1LIlNtyfmB2WzxXt73dlMZzo98iGez1bwa8vrq-jdHl258sfhy9SsRH2y_d1XP3_Kf7M4l8AAAD__8QGluU)

_But here 's the problem, Friend... _

Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help.

Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare.

Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs.

**And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. **

_But there 's not much time left before the doors open... _

I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life...

For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change.

The moment they realize they are NOT alone.

The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America.

The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for.

Because if we want to save this country...

**We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. **

That's the mission.

And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next.

Please help us make sure no young woman is left behind.

Let's fill San Antonio with women ready to LIVE boldly... Stand confidently in truth... LOVE AMERICA again...

And help WIN the American Culture War.

Because they know something very important, Friend... If they can win the hearts and minds of young women... They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations. And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events. And I can honestly tell you: I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now. Because modern culture is failing them. The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment." They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism. And after years of hearing those lies... So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty. They're searching for something REAL. Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down. That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage. From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: ✅ Strengthen their minds ✅ Cultivate wellness ✅ Step boldly into their purpose ✅ Anchor their spirits in faith And when they walk into that room... Something changes. Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time. Young women arriving unsure of themselves... Then leaving with fire in their eyes. Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing: " There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." That matters. Because the Left wants these young women isolated. Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate. But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger. A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. And these women don't just leave inspired... They go home ready to LEAD. I've watched women leave WLS and: 🔥 Strengthen their faith 🔥 Embrace their femininity 🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose 🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses 🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters 🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time. But here 's the problem, Friend... Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help. Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare. Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs. And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. But there 's not much time left before the doors open... I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life... That's why I'm personally asking: For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change. The moment they realize they are NOT alone. The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America. The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for. Because if we want to save this country... We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. That's the mission. And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next. Please help us make sure no young woman is left behind. Let's fill San Antonio with women ready to LIVE boldly... Stand confidently in truth... LOVE AMERICA again... And help WIN the American Culture War. | | | For Charlie, Lauren Toncich Vice President of Events Turning Point USA P.S. name: Trina Swanson
subject: Nothing short of neglectful.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trina for Congress
body:
trinaforcongress.com [trinaforcongress.com]
Friend,
As I listen to voters all across the 8th – From the Northwest Angle down to Forest Lake and up to Grand Portage – it’s clear that folks are ready for something better.
That was made even more clear last night, when Pete Stauber again hid from the people who elected him. His “town hall” last night via phone call was typical of his unwillingness to go out and actually talk to the people he represents. Rather than showing up in person, he doubled down on what a great job he thinks the current administration is doing.
We disagree.
Main streets across our district are growing emptier each year. Rural health clinics and hospitals have downsized or closed entirely. Groceries and bills continue to get more expensive. Even veterinary care has gotten pricier, as Pete Stauber’s friends in the private equity industry buy out local practices and increase prices to care for our pets and farm animals.
Minnesotans are feeling the pinch of rising prices, while Stauber is more interested in making his corporate donors happy than focusing on the real issues facing our communities, and his lack of leadership is nothing short of neglectful .
Northern and central Minnesota deserve better than Stauber, and I’m ready to deliver a new type of leadership for MN-08. But at any moment, right-wing special interests could dump dark money into this race, and we need to be ready to fight back.

| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---

_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

body:

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9795%2E5257348%2ErOetVH)
Derek, The Supreme Court recently handed down a decision that makes it dramatically harder to challenge racial gerrymanders in federal court — a blow to the basic idea that every vote should count equally and maps should not be drawn to disenfranchise minority voters. It shouldn’t come as a surprise from _this_ Supreme Court. They are no longer a conservative court, but a nakedly partisan one – bent on helping Republicans electorally and giving extraordinary new powers to a deeply immoral Republican president. What comes next will surprise nobody. When courts remove the tools to stop discriminatory maps, politicians will rig districts to silence whole communities. [**Will you stand with me and demand Congress act to stop partisan gerrymandering for good? I’ve been fighting for years for legislation that does this — and it’s clearly needed now more than ever.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2605_votingrights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260515_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9795%2E5257348%2ErOetVH) | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2605_votingrights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260515_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=9795%2E5257348%2ErOetVH)
---
Here’s why this matters: the Voting Rights Act has been one of the last protections that communities had to challenge maps diluting Black, Latino, Asian American, and Native American voting power.
I’ve fought partisan gerrymandering my entire career because fair maps that protect all communities are the foundation of a functioning democracy.
Without them, some votes and voters are worth more than others. Communities lose influence in Congress, and policies that reflect real needs — from housing to climate resilience to criminal justice reform — get pushed aside.
That’s why we need _**a nationwide ban on gerrymandering**_. So politicians cannot pick their voters, and voters get to pick their representatives.
[**It’s high time we set a nationwide, bipartisan standard to end racial gerrymandering and restore meaningful representation. Add your name in support today.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2605_votingrights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260515_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=9795%2E5257348%2ErOetVH)

When we act together — by adding our names and making our priorities clear — we force Washington to listen and act to protect every voter.
Thanks,
Adam

Friend,

It feels like most of the news coming out of D.C. these days is just theater — performative attacks and flashy soundbites that don’t actually do a thing to help our families here at home.

Real progress — the kind that helps our veterans access the health care they need or protects the Bay — is quiet. It shows up in the work done in committee rooms, in bipartisan negotiations, and in “small wins” that build on one another to deliver real, lasting change for Marylanders.

I’m not in Congress to become a viral sensation — I’m more interested in passing bills than getting likes. I’m here to get things done for Maryland. If you value substance over spectacle, will you chip in $15 to help me keep this work going? This week NBA Legend Charles Barkley went viral again after speaking emotionally about Jason Collins -- the first openly gay player in major American professional sports -- and talking openly about the homophobia that still exists in this country, particularly in sports culture and in parts of the Black community.
Barkley praised Collins for having the courage to come out publicly, defended LGBTQ people unapologetically, and said out loud what a lot of powerful public figures are still too cowardly to admit: America remains deeply homophobic despite how much progress people pretend we've made:
### "There is such animosity toward the gay community. That's what's really unfortunate. If you think there's not more gay players in the NFL, Major League Baseball and the NBA, you're just stupid."
And honestly, listening to him talk about it, you could hear something that feels increasingly rare in public life right now: actual sincerity.
Not PR-tested empathy. Not corporate diversity language. Not some carefully managed statement written by consultants trying not to upset advertisers or alienate half an audience.

* * *
Real emotion, compassion, and respect for what it costs somebody to stand up publicly and tell the truth about who they are in a country that still punishes people for being different.
That's why Barkley stands out right now.
Not because he's an NBA legend. Not because he's rich. Not because he's one of the funniest people on television.
He stands out because he keeps choosing decency even when there's a cost attached to it. And right now, that's become weirdly uncommon.
We live in this era where so many celebrities, athletes, and public figures are terrified of upsetting anyone. Everything is filtered through PR teams, audience analytics, and brand protection. Everybody wants to appear compassionate right up until compassion becomes inconvenient.
But Barkley keeps saying things anyway.
And in this climate, that kind of honesty stands out.
Especially because this isn't the first time he's done it.
Just a few months ago MAGA influencers were demanding he get fired after he defended immigrants and criticized the cruelty of Trump-era immigration politics. Steve Bannon publicly attacked him. Right-wing media personalities melted down online. The MAGA outrage machine immediately went after him because that's what happens now anytime somebody with a massive platform publicly sides with immigrants, LGBTQ people, or anybody conservatives have decided should be treated as disposable.
That's the ecosystem we're living in right now. And Charles Barkley keeps refusing to submit to it.
That's the part I respect most because he doesn't actually have to do any of this.
The guy is one of the most famous athletes alive. He's rich beyond comprehension. He could spend the rest of his life golfing, cashing checks, and avoiding controversy entirely. Nobody would blame him.
Instead, he keeps using his platform to defend people who are being targeted -- LGBTQ people, immigrants, trans people, and basically anybody the modern outrage machine decides should be mocked, demonized, or dehumanized this week.
And honestly, more celebrities should act like this.
Because if you build a massive platform in America -- if millions of people buy your jerseys, watch your games, support your endorsements, and make you rich beyond imagination -- then you actually do have a responsibility to use that influence for something bigger than protecting your own brand.
That's what Barkley understands that so many public figures don't.
What makes him different from a lot of celebrities is that he doesn't sound like somebody trying to win points. He sounds like somebody reacting instinctively to cruelty.
That authenticity is powerful because people can tell the difference between somebody performing empathy and somebody actually feeling it.
And honestly, I think that's part of why the right gets so angry at him specifically. Barkley breaks the caricature they want to sell people. He's not some Hollywood actor reading activist slogans off cue cards. He's not some academic speaking in sanitized political language.
He's Charles Barkley -- this larger-than-life basketball legend who talks like a normal person and still arrives at the conclusion that treating people with dignity is good actually.
That drives these people insane.
* * *
**Mid-rant note: this section is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've started paying less attention to which headlines are the loudest and more attention to how differently the same story gets presented depending on where you read it.
Most news coverage doesn't just report events -- it filters them. Different outlets emphasize different angles, ignore different facts, and frame stories in ways that shape how we interpret them before we've even had time to think critically ourselves.
That's why I've been using Ground News.
My team and I use it because context matters, especially when coverage starts feeling a little too uniform.

[ Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/91af7cc8-b309-46a9-bcf4-37174aca8743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Because the modern MAGA movement increasingly depends on convincing Americans that compassion itself is weakness. That empathy is fake. That cruelty is honesty. That bullying is strength.
And Barkley completely rejects that worldview just by being himself.
He's been doing this for years, by the way.
People forget Barkley publicly campaigned against Roy Moore in Alabama because he thought Moore was dangerous and tied to extremism. He's criticized Republicans repeatedly over the years. He's called out racism, homophobia, and political corruption. Every single time he does it, there's this wave of backlash from people who believe celebrities should only use their platform when it benefits conservatives.
Otherwise they should "shut up and dribble."
Funny how that only works in one direction.
Conservatives only seem to hate political celebrities when those celebrities are defending marginalized people. When athletes promote nationalism, Trump, anti-LGBTQ rhetoric, or right-wing grievance politics, suddenly activism is perfectly acceptable.
The rule is actually much simpler than that: conservative speech is allowed, humanitarian speech gets punished.
And moments like this have a bigger impact than people think.
When Barkley says gay people deserve respect, somebody hears that who desperately needs to hear it. When he tells trans people he loves them, some terrified kid sees that clip and feels a little less alone. When he speaks up for immigrants or marginalized people or anybody being targeted by the mob, he reminds people that decency still exists in public life.
And look -- I know some people roll their eyes at this stuff. They think celebrity opinions don't matter.
But culture matters. Representation matters. Visibility matters.
There's a reason authoritarian movements spend so much time trying to silence artists, athletes, journalists, comedians, and entertainers. Culture shapes how people see each other. It shapes what becomes normal. It shapes who gets treated as human.
That's why the backlash against Barkley is always so intense. He's using a massive platform to normalize empathy in a political movement that increasingly survives on cruelty.
And honestly, we need more of that.
We need more public figures willing to risk backlash instead of treating moral courage like a branding exercise. We need more people willing to defend vulnerable communities before it becomes socially safe to do so. And we desperately need more people who understand that having influence comes with responsibility.
And the fact that basic empathy now feels rebellious in American public life says something deeply broken about the culture MAGA has built around outrage, intimidation, and cruelty.
That's why Charles Barkley resonates with so many people right now.
Because he's one of the few celebrities still willing to use his platform like a human being instead of a corporation.

clean_body: And he's exposing waht's broken about American culture. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? And he's exposing what's broken about American culture. | | | May 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | This week NBA Legend Charles Barkley went viral again after speaking emotionally about Jason Collins -- the first openly gay player in major American professional sports -- and talking openly about the homophobia that still exists in this country, particularly in sports culture and in parts of the Black community. Barkley praised Collins for having the courage to come out publicly, defended LGBTQ people unapologetically, and said out loud what a lot of powerful public figures are still too cowardly to admit: America remains deeply homophobic despite how much progress people pretend we've made: "There is such animosity toward the gay community. That's what's really unfortunate. If you think there's not more gay players in the NFL, Major League Baseball and the NBA, you're just stupid." And honestly, listening to him talk about it, you could hear something that feels increasingly rare in public life right now: actual sincerity. Not PR-tested empathy. Not corporate diversity language. Not some carefully managed statement written by consultants trying not to upset advertisers or alienate half an audience. Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News. The more headlines I scroll through, the more I realize how easy it is to mistake visibility for importance. That's why I've been using Ground News. It aggregates reporting from thousands of sources and makes it easy to compare coverage side by side -- including political leanings, ownership, and factuality ratings. You can quickly see where narratives overlap, where they diverge, and which parts of a story are getting the most attention. I've been a paying user since before they ever sponsored Endless Urgency. I use it because it makes it a lot harder to be misled. They're completely subscriber funded, so there are no corporate interests pushing a narrative on what you see. Understanding the stories that aren't getting equal attention can completely change how you see the ones that are. | | ---|---|--- Real emotion, compassion, and respect for what it costs somebody to stand up publicly and tell the truth about who they are in a country that still punishes people for being different. That's why Barkley stands out right now. Not because he's an NBA legend. Not because he's rich. Not because he's one of the funniest people on television. He stands out because he keeps choosing decency even when there's a cost attached to it. And right now, that's become weirdly uncommon. We live in this era where so many celebrities, athletes, and public figures are terrified of upsetting anyone. Everything is filtered through PR teams, audience analytics, and brand protection. Everybody wants to appear compassionate right up until compassion becomes inconvenient. But Barkley keeps saying things anyway. And in this climate, that kind of honesty stands out. Especially because this isn't the first time he's done it. Just a few months ago MAGA influencers were demanding he get fired after he defended immigrants and criticized the cruelty of Trump-era immigration politics. Steve Bannon publicly attacked him. Right-wing media personalities melted down online. The MAGA outrage machine immediately went after him because that's what happens now anytime somebody with a massive platform publicly sides with immigrants, LGBTQ people, or anybody conservatives have decided should be treated as disposable. That's the ecosystem we're living in right now. And Charles Barkley keeps refusing to submit to it. That's the part I respect most because he doesn't actually have to do any of this. The guy is one of the most famous athletes alive. He's rich beyond comprehension. He could spend the rest of his life golfing, cashing checks, and avoiding controversy entirely. Nobody would blame him. Instead, he keeps using his platform to defend people who are being targeted -- LGBTQ people, immigrants, trans people, and basically anybody the modern outrage machine decides should be mocked, demonized, or dehumanized this week. And honestly, more celebrities should act like this. Because if you build a massive platform in America -- if millions of people buy your jerseys, watch your games, support your endorsements, and make you rich beyond imagination -- then you actually do have a responsibility to use that influence for something bigger than protecting your own brand. That's what Barkley understands that so many public figures don't. What makes him different from a lot of celebrities is that he doesn't sound like somebody trying to win points. He sounds like somebody reacting instinctively to cruelty. That authenticity is powerful because people can tell the difference between somebody performing empathy and somebody actually feeling it. And honestly, I think that's part of why the right gets so angry at him specifically. Barkley breaks the caricature they want to sell people. He's not some Hollywood actor reading activist slogans off cue cards. He's not some academic speaking in sanitized political language. He's Charles Barkley -- this larger-than-life basketball legend who talks like a normal person and still arrives at the conclusion that treating people with dignity is good actually. That drives these people insane. Mid-rant note: this section is sponsored by Ground News. I've started paying less attention to which headlines are the loudest and more attention to how differently the same story gets presented depending on where you read it. Most news coverage doesn't just report events -- it filters them. Different outlets emphasize different angles, ignore different facts, and frame stories in ways that shape how we interpret them before we've even had time to think critically ourselves. That's why I've been using Ground News. My team and I use it because context matters, especially when coverage starts feeling a little too uniform. Try it today! Because the modern MAGA movement increasingly depends on convincing Americans that compassion itself is weakness. That empathy is fake. That cruelty is honesty. That bullying is strength. And Barkley completely rejects that worldview just by being himself. He's been doing this for years, by the way. People forget Barkley publicly campaigned against Roy Moore in Alabama because he thought Moore was dangerous and tied to extremism. He's criticized Republicans repeatedly over the years. He's called out racism, homophobia, and political corruption. Every single time he does it, there's this wave of backlash from people who believe celebrities should only use their platform when it benefits conservatives. Otherwise they should "shut up and dribble." Funny how that only works in one direction. Conservatives only seem to hate political celebrities when those celebrities are defending marginalized people. When athletes promote nationalism, Trump, anti-LGBTQ rhetoric, or right-wing grievance politics, suddenly activism is perfectly acceptable. The rule is actually much simpler than that: conservative speech is allowed, humanitarian speech gets punished. And moments like this have a bigger impact than people think. When Barkley says gay people deserve respect, somebody hears that who desperately needs to hear it. When he tells trans people he loves them, some terrified kid sees that clip and feels a little less alone. When he speaks up for immigrants or marginalized people or anybody being targeted by the mob, he reminds people that decency still exists in public life. And look -- I know some people roll their eyes at this stuff. They think celebrity opinions don't matter. But culture matters. Representation matters. Visibility matters. There's a reason authoritarian movements spend so much time trying to silence artists, athletes, journalists, comedians, and entertainers. Culture shapes how people see each other. It shapes what becomes normal. It shapes who gets treated as human. That's why the backlash against Barkley is always so intense. He's using a massive platform to normalize empathy in a political movement that increasingly survives on cruelty. And honestly, we need more of that. We need more public figures willing to risk backlash instead of treating moral courage like a branding exercise. We need more people willing to defend vulnerable communities before it becomes socially safe to do so. And we desperately need more people who understand that having influence comes with responsibility. And the fact that basic empathy now feels rebellious in American public life says something deeply broken about the culture MAGA has built around outrage, intimidation, and cruelty. That's why Charles Barkley resonates with so many people right now. Because he's one of the few celebrities still willing to use his platform like a human being instead of a corporation. The Trump administration and Republicans in Congress and across the country are redrawing maps and pushing restrictive voting rules that ultimately hurt Black voices and limit voting power. The protections provided by the Voting Rights Act were born out of the Civil Rights movement and the blood and sacrifice of so many. I was born into a generation that enjoys civil rights we did not have to fight for. But Republicans are working to undo this progress — they are more concerned about holding onto power than guaranteeing voting access and autonomy in Black, Latino, and other communities of color. ## Primary Day is May 19!
Remember to Vote if you can. and if you live near on of these candidates, consider helping them out on this very important day.
### 1\. District 196 Special Election
[ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=5) Forward Democrat Ron Ruman is running in a special election, which will be held on primary day. He's popular with independent voters, and expects to appeal to them in the general election this November... but those independent voters often miss special elections that are held on primary day because they're used to being excluded from the primaries. If you live in the York County area, [reach out to Ron's campaign](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=6) and see if you can help.
### 2\. Independents Gathering Signatures
One of the main challenges for independent candidates is organizing volunteers to gather signatures. Are you interested in helping? Then the **best day to do it is primary day**. Signatures can be collected at polling places, giving volunteers easy access to registered voters in the district. (When you're outside the two-party system, you have to work smart to get ahead!). **Contact us ASAP to offer your help- even if it's just a few hours.** [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=s9-xbJ9sz3bHEgiwz34eSeP_9PVXxrs7OtvmmZwVwC8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=7) [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=C67zBN9acu3ZSVmLPV47pUdQZk8NryxM-7BS68Thx8D2qdpFaAuEG-y1-R0I3wXv&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=8) Chris and Rodney are both running for the Pennsylvania State House and have been officially endorsed by the PA Forward Party.
#### Other Independents on Our Radar
We believe that independent candidates deserve more attention, so here are some other independent candidates to consider: [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=9WO7-Xnf8yu_5tCpEnOMYzimbQi3tdmQwRDGziOwWzU42nl8vREdHKYtvkvwRPQy&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=9) [Isabelle Harman for PA's 10th Congressional District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=9WO7-Xnf8yu_5tCpEnOMYzimbQi3tdmQwRDGziOwWzU42nl8vREdHKYtvkvwRPQy&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=10) [Jenn Brothers for PA's 9th Congressional District](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KO8ZOB0mq2gq63DvFrKfeyK1qZFx7bNIR-pYCJqTbAm2E5qjTfmb3LDdeZ-obBEdLmgPDtRTDoKrdYLbHKr-4Q&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=11) [Drew Bingaman for PA State House District 108](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KO8ZOB0mq2gq63DvFrKfeyK1qZFx7bNIR-pYCJqTbAnskGqyFERUHJy-r0gnfT01k3VrmSnvefb7ABjEk_NtIw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=12) Please let us know of any other candidates you think we should be aware of—even Republicans or Democrats. The Forward Party is a movement of independent thinkers. **Our movement is larger than our party.** **If you’re tired of waiting for the system to fix itself — this is your moment.****
**👥[ Volunteer ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u70WFq0sATb-gX6urIv4GZpjPn9GCnDZk_UeXCQ69mEO&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=13)| 🗳️ [Run for Office ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uyJ8qnt6OtAJ8RH9n1TXdquN-NHBoHH5LkgJCQAnsd4c&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=14)| 💸[ Donate](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u-umgjlfzqeAM_zj2h1YgEQ-K66QrOZInc9VmoBs32pq_y7QGt_LcVXvgyuNA2mVOA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=15) | 🌐 [paforwardparty.com](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=HVvciMFi8RAP9WOHgyYb4IuwIPN8xGvygA6-CgoZgwI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_may_call_invite&n=16)

body:
Will you chip in to strengthen our fight to protect our democracy and hold the Trump administration accountable? |
#
---

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

# [They Call It Leadership. I Call It Cowardice.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=197891354&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3ODkxMzU0LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg4ODI3ODUsImV4cCI6MTc4MTQ3NDc4NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc1MzQxNzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.IkleGhZvpudYMwykhbtcP-teJatG59OXQLSmd5u6QBM)

They strut around with flag pins and tough talk and manufactured outrage. But let me tell you what the members of the Tennessee General Assembly who voted for this redistricting scam really are.
## Cowards.
These are not leaders. They are political house pets. They wait to be told what to think. They heel to the big orange in the Oval Office and the second daddy calls, they roll over. | Peter — **[I'm hosting a town hall and I need you there](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/PJ9gILa12Ei0ZeYFVyCloGxtLv4wBHrP/click?signature=ecd742875ff2567fecdcc05451872a6dae09b05e&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fget-big-money-out-of-politics-town-hall-with-melat-kiros)**. Melat

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3MTM3ODAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ2MDYxMDE5NAS2&mt=1&rt=0).

With Pearce in charge, our public lands, waters, and national monuments across the country are at an even greater risk of being sold off to oil and gas developers, which would devastate our most treasured places and jeopardize the health, safety, and livelihoods of communities across the country.
---

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Another month on the road:
body:
Traveling all across Texas
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
It’s been an exciting time on the road so far, meeting Texans where they’re at and hearing about what issues matter most to them — _and I would not trade it for anything._
From San Antonio to Fort Worth, El Paso to Houston, I am working to earn every vote by showing up and putting in the work in every corner of our state. But I can’t do it alone.
**I have a mid-month fundraising deadline tomorrow night at midnight,** and I have a goal to raise **_$50,000_** to stay on track for my campaign's monthly fundraising goal.
**[So, if you can, will you chip in $5 right now to help me reach my fundraising goal, keep me on the road, and build the movement it’ll take to beat Greg Abbott?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&amount=5&t=1&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)**
Here are a few pictures in film that my team has taken this month:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)
I attended a charreada during Fiesta, an annual festival in San Antonio that celebrates Mexican American culture.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&%3Bamount=5&t=3&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)
I met with welders who told me the same thing I’m hearing everywhere I go. People are working harder than ever, but it still feels like they’re still just getting by. These are the Texans who power our economy, and they deserve leadership that actually fights for them.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&%3Bamount=5&t=4&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)
In city after city, I’m meeting with local leaders who are solving problems in their communities every day. These leaders are asking for a governor who starts delivering and doesn’t leave them behind.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&%3Bamount=5&t=5&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)
Here, I’m outside of a gas station calling on Greg Abbott to temporarily suspend the state gas tax. Working-class families are stretched thin, and overnight gas has jumped by more than a dollar in some places. As governor, I will address the affordability crisis and find solutions that will support Texas families.
It was a very busy and eye-opening time so far on the campaign trail, and I couldn’t have done it without you, Peter. Because I have support from you and this grassroots team, I’m able to travel across Texas and share how we’re going to kick Greg Abbott out of office and win in November.
But we still have six months left until November, and we could use all of the support right now to keep on traveling and persuading voters to turn out on Election Day.
**[So, if you can, will you pitch in $5 right now to keep me on the road and reach my mid-month fundraising goal by tomorrow night at midnight?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&refcode=em20260515-1132&amount=5&t=6&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260515_2.yBRjA1&amount=5&refcode=em20260515-1132&t=25&akid=1132%2E299639%2EQ0Wmf-)
Thanks for your support. I hope you enjoyed the photos!
Gina Hinojosa

that night. That feeling we all felt when it became clear Donald Trump

name: The Democrats
subject: You are not an ATM. You are an invaluable part of our organization.
body:
---
Derek, If you’re on other email lists, you probably receive panicked emails from PACs and politicians trying to scare you into donating. That’s especially true right now, with the mid-month deadline **tonight** and November’s midterm elections rapidly approaching. Maybe you’re already seeing your inbox flooded with requests for donations. But here’s what we believe, Derek:
* **You are _not_ an ATM.** You are an invaluable part of our organization and our mission.
* We strive to give you valuable information about the DNC’s work that we hope will inspire you to join us — not scare you into making a rushed decision based on a false sense of urgency.
* Our goal is always to make sure you have accurate, up-to-date information about how we put your grassroots contribution to work.

So here’s the truth: The DNC is the only organization working around the clock, _every single year_ , to distribute funds and resources to all 50 state parties and the races that need it most. We have a team of experts on staff who spend their days strategizing to help Democrats fight back, organize, and win elections. We set our fundraising goals thoughtfully and intentionally to ensure that we have the resources we need to continue that work, all over the country. [**So, Derek, when you receive an email from the DNC asking for your support, that’s exactly where your contribution goes. Your contribution will help us organize across the country, register new Democrats in key swing states, and work towards winning back Congress this year. The University of West Alabama and the City of Livingston are partnering for an infrastructure improvement project through a new federal award of $3.093 million from the Department of Homeland Security Appropriations supported by U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Ala.).

“We are deeply appreciative of Senator Britt’s continued support for our region, and we are honored to partner with the City of Livingston to activate the infrastructure development project that will improve safety, strengthen campus and community connectivity, support future construction, and help position Livingston and Sumter County for new investment and job creation,” said UWA President Dr. Todd G. The site is a clearinghouse of resources for expecting and new mothers, covering nutrition, breastfeeding, mental health, adoption, and the administration’s new “Trump Accounts” savings program for newborns.
